text.description_html:
Acorn IWYBD, Iron Art Egg Knob Interior Dummy Handleset

The square shape of the Acorn Made IWYBD Mortise Dummy Handleset gives it a timeless look. It would look just as great in a more modern home as it would leading into a room full of antiques. A dummy handleset, it neither laches nor locks.

Iron Art is a unique line of products created by hand using the techniques of the traditional forge.

Dummy Handleset: Blank trim for non-working doors that does not have a turnpiece or a cylinder. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Also Available Matching 9-7/8 Inch Mortise Skeleton Key Iron Art Lockset With Egg Knob

Features and Specifications of the Rectangle Dummy Lockset with Oval Knob:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 9-7/8"
  • Width: 2-3/8"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Height: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Width: 1-1/2"

Sold Individually
